BiblicalUsage: Chagowr means belted, girded. The virtuous woman makes fine linen and sells girdles to the merchant, and Ezekiel sees the Babylonian captains girded with girdles upon their loins, in dyed attire, all of them princes to look to.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a girdle is honest work in one verse and painted pride in the other, and the difference is who is wearing it and why.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
